title: Irish Mob
reason: Only 6 usable pages, covering just two regional strands (the Westies of Hell's Kitchen; Montreal's West End Gang) plus an off-topic Cleveland newspaper circulation war. The title is a broad umbrella across the US and Canada; Boston, Chicago and Prohibition-era sources were 403/410/THIN or unreachable and search engines failed. Not enough sourced, on-subject facts for 1,000 words without padding. Sources also conflict (Coonan sentence 60 years per Crime Museum vs 75 per Mob Museum/W42ST).
